items.question: What time does check-in start?
items.answer: Check-in is from 14:00 to 18:00.

items.question: What time is check-out?
items.answer: Check-out is at 10:00.

items.question: Can I check in early?
items.answer: We will guide you as soon as your room is ready, where possible. If you have a specific request, please contact us in advance.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my reservation?
items.answer: As a guide, cancellations are free up to 4 days before your stay, 30% of the room rate for 3-2 days before, 50% the day before, and 100% on the day or for a no-show. Policies may vary by date during busy seasons, so please check the exact terms at the time of booking. If you booked through a reservation website, you can change or cancel directly from your booking management page on that site. If you booked by phone, please contact us by phone.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept cash and major credit cards. Please also check the confirmation details at the time of booking.

items.question: Can I see Lake Toya from my room?
items.answer: Depending on room type, rooms face either the lake or the mountains. If you'd like a lake view, please request it at the time of booking.

items.question: Do you have non-smoking rooms?
items.answer: We're sorry, but we do not have non-smoking rooms. There is no smoking area inside the hotel, but a smoking space is available to the left as you exit the hotel.

items.question: What amenities are provided?
items.answer: We provide basic amenities such as toothbrushes, towels, pajamas, and a hair dryer. Please check the rooms page for details.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi available?
items.answer: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel and in all guest rooms.

items.question: Do rooms have a refrigerator?
items.answer: Yes, all guest rooms have a refrigerator.

items.question: What are the onsen hours?
items.answer: [For overnight guests] The large public bath is open 13:00–9:30 the next day (closed 23:00–23:30 and 9:30–13:00 for cleaning); the open-air bath is open 13:00–23:00.

items.question: Do you have a private bath?
items.answer: We're sorry, but we do not have a private bath.

items.question: Do you have a sauna?
items.answer: We're sorry, but we do not have a sauna.

items.question: Can I bathe if I have tattoos?
items.answer: We ask guests with tattoos to refrain from bathing.

items.question: Can I use the onsen as a day-trip visitor?
items.answer: Yes. Reception hours are 13:00–20:00 (last entry), and usage hours are 13:00–21:00. Bathing fees are ¥600 for adults and ¥300 for children (age 3 to elementary school). We may decline day-trip bathing during busy periods or on special days — thank you for your understanding.

items.question: Are towels available for day-trip bathing?
items.answer: Rentals are available: bath towel ¥300, face towel ¥100. Shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and hair dryers are free to use.

items.question: What time are dinner and breakfast served?
items.answer: Dinner is served from 18:00 in the banquet hall ("Omakase Japanese Kaiseki Course," last seating 19:00). Breakfast is a Japanese-style set served in the banquet hall. We cannot serve dinner after 19:00, and there is no change or refund to your accommodation fee in that case.

items.question: Can you accommodate food allergies?
items.answer: We will accommodate where possible. Please let us know at the time of booking, or by phone at least 3 days in advance.

items.question: Is in-room dining available?
items.answer: Yes, for some plans. Please check our reservation page for details.

items.question: Do you offer plans without meals?
items.answer: Yes, we do. Please check our reservation page for details.

items.question: What should I do if I'll arrive late on a dinner-included plan?
items.answer: If you expect to arrive late, please contact the hotel in advance.

items.question: Is there a children's rate?
items.answer: Rates vary depending on age and whether meals are included. Please check the rate table at the time of booking.

items.question: Do you have baby cribs available?
items.answer: We have a limited number, so please ask at the time of booking.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: We offer free parking. Our staff will meet and guide you upon your arrival at the hotel.

items.question: Do you offer a shuttle service?
items.answer: We do not currently offer a shuttle service. Please use a taxi or local bus from the nearest station.

items.question: How long does it take from the nearest station?
items.answer: About 10 minutes by taxi from JR Toya Station. Please see the access page for details.

items.question: Can you call a taxi for me?
items.answer: Yes, our front desk can arrange a taxi for you. Please feel free to ask.

items.question: Is there a convenience store I can use?
items.answer: There isn't one inside the hotel, but there is a convenience store about a 5-minute walk away.

items.question: Can I bring my own drinks?
items.answer: Yes, you're welcome to bring drinks into your room.

items.question: Is there a smoking area?
items.answer: There is no smoking area inside the hotel. Please use the smoking space to the left as you exit the hotel.

items.question: Do you have karaoke, table tennis, or a bar?
items.answer: Karaoke in the banquet hall is available for group guests only. We do not have table tennis or a bar.

items.question: Can I bring a pet?
items.answer: We're sorry, but pets are not permitted.
